-77.09350,39.00180.name: Shady Grove Fertility-Walter Reed, Walter Reed National Military Medical Center
-77.09350,39.00180.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Micah J. Hill, DO. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

7.58783,47.55811.name: Novartis Pharma AG
7.58783,47.55811.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-122.34930,47.62050.name: Gates Foundation — committed grants database
-122.34930,47.62050.desc: Every grant the foundation has committed, searchable by recipient and amount. It matters because philanthropy is among the largest funders of putting engineered organisms into the ground in low-income countries — which means the usual test of whether farmers want a product, that they buy it, never happens. This database is how you find out who was paid to do what, and it is unusually complete for a private funder.

-0.62800,48.35600.name: Janvier Labs
-0.62800,48.35600.desc: A major European supplier of laboratory rodents, serving research across the continent. Europe publishes animal-use statistics through ALURES, which makes it one of the few places where the scale of this trade is officially counted — and the count exists because the EU legislated for it, not because the industry offered it.

78.04000,30.32000.name: Navdanya / seed sovereignty movement
78.04000,30.32000.desc: Runs community seed banks and campaigns against seed patenting in India. It is the longest-running organised opposition to this industry anywhere, and its central claim — that seed saving is a right rather than an infringement — is the one UPOV 91 was written to settle the other way.

-118.25510,34.14250.name: Growing Generations
-118.25510,34.14250.desc: Founded in 1996 and among the first US agencies working with gay and lesbian couples and single men, at a time when that route to parenthood was closed almost everywhere else. Packages run from roughly $180,000 to over $300,000. It operates as a subsidiary of a Boston holding company inside a private equity portfolio — the same holding company that owns the Boston agency above and a third agency besides. That is the entry: two of the most prominent surrogacy agencies in the United States, presented as separate choices and reviewing each other in published guides, share an owner. The consolidation pattern this map documents in seed and in poultry genetics runs here too, in a service where the product is a pregnancy.
